capabilities.name: reserve a book that is on loan
capabilities.description: A member reserves a book that another member has on loan.

capabilities.name: return a book
capabilities.description: When a member returns a book, the system updates the loan record.

capabilities.name: register and deactivate members
capabilities.description: The librarian registers new members and deactivates members.

capabilities.name: send reminder emails before the due date
capabilities.description: The system may send reminder emails to members before a loan is due.

capabilities.name: subscribe to the Flexible Loan plan
capabilities.description: A member subscribes to the Flexible Loan plan.

capabilities.name: response time of the search function
capabilities.description: The search function must respond within a stated time.
